/* 容器 */
.portable-infobox {
  border: 1px solid #C9BBA0 !important;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #F7F1E4 !important;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.portable-infobox .pi-title {
  background: #1B2A41 !important;
  color: #EDE4D3 !important;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border-left: 4px solid #B08D57 !important;
  margin: 0;
}

.portable-infobox .pi-header {
  background: #EDE4D3 !important;
  color: #1B2A41 !important;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 13px;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-left: 4px solid #B08D57 !important;
  border-top: 1px solid #C9BBA0 !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #C9BBA0 !important;
}

/* 数据行：标签靠左、值靠右分布 */
.portable-infobox .pi-data {
  display: flex;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #EDE4D3 !important;
}
.portable-infobox .pi-item:last-child .pi-data {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.portable-infobox .pi-data-label {
  flex: 0 0 110px;
  color: #2B2621 !important;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.portable-infobox .pi-data-value {
  flex: 1;
  color: #2B2621 !important;
  font-size: 13px;
}

/* 图片说明文字（若以后加图） */
.portable-infobox .pi-caption {
  background: #EDE4D3 !important;
  color: #6b5f4f !important;
  font-size: 11px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  text-align: center;
}
